metadata.document: Sustainable Seas: Managing the Marine Environment

cleaned_body_text: Lucy Brake and Raewyn Peart. The Environmental Defence Society is a charitable organisation which has been operating since 1971. It is committed to protecting New Zealand's marine environment and managing marine resources sustainably. Oceans are enormously important to human lives, covering more than 70 per cent of the globe. New Zealand has jurisdiction over a very large, varied and productive marine environment, with a coastline of approximately 19,000 to 20,500 kilometres bordering a marine area extending over 5.8 million square kilometres. This book demystifies a complex and overlapping legislative framework by clearly describing how decisions affecting the environment, members of the public and others are made through the application of best practice approaches.
